description: Unit tests for SbMicrophone API, testing microphone reading functionality under various conditions.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneReadTest.SunnyDay
methods.description: Tests successful microphone read operation under normal conditions.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneReadTest.SunnyDayReadIsLargerThanMinReadSize
methods.description: Tests reading more data than the minimum read size.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneReadTest.SunnyDayOpenSleepCloseAndOpenRead
methods.description: Tests opening, sleeping, closing, reopening, and reading from the microphone.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneReadTest.RainyDayAudioBufferIsNULL
methods.description: Tests reading with a NULL buffer, expecting zero bytes read.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneReadTest.RainyDayAudioBufferSizeIsSmallerThanRequestedSize
methods.description: Tests reading with a NULL buffer and a large requested size, expecting failure.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneReadTest.RainyDayAudioBufferSizeIsSmallerThanMinReadSize
methods.description: Tests reading with a buffer smaller than the minimum read size.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneReadTest.RainyDayOpenIsNotCalled
methods.description: Tests reading without opening the microphone first, expecting failure.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneReadTest.RainyDayOpenCloseAndRead
methods.description: Tests opening, closing, and then reading from the microphone.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneReadTest.RainyDayMicrophoneIsInvalid
methods.description: Tests reading from an invalid microphone handle.
